thread:
alice: Heads-up — spotted a user bug when swapping models in prod. The migration guide for v1->v2 doesn't mention embed-dim changes; users get downstream errors when the new model returns 1024-d vectors but tutorials assume 1536.

ben: Which guide/PR is this? Can you drop a link or example?

alice: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421 — root cause is a model_alias swap to 'redwood-embed-2' that changed dim 1536->1024. Our code snippets still show `vector.length` checks but no explicit migration steps.

sam: Oh right — remember we removed the client-side compatibility shim in the v2 SDK. We should add a clear migration note + a short fallback snippet. @maya @carol can you sync with SDK owners?

maya: I'm on sdk-oss. Quick question: do we prefer showing client-side reshape logic or recommending a server-side mapping/fallback? I lean server-side mapping + a warning in the guide.

carol: I can draft the docs PR with both options: server-side mapping example and a tiny client-side detection snippet. Draft snippet idea:
```js
// old
const v = await client.embeddings.create({model: 'redwood-embed-legacy', input: ['...']})
// new
const v = await client.embeddings.create({model: 'redwood-embed-2', input: ['...']})
if (v[0].length !== 1536) {
  // handle fallback: route to legacy or surface a clear error message
}
```
But we should avoid prescribing unsafe reshape math.

ben: +1 for server-side mapping note. Also add a migration checklist: how to detect mismatched dims, fallback routing to legacy host, and a link to the rollout strategy for model swaps.

alice: Also found another snippet where param `input` is renamed to `inputs` in the v2 client example — that'll break copy-paste. Need an SDK check to align snippets with the release.

maya: I'll update the SDK snippet templates and add a compatibility note in the changelog. I'll also add a deprecation blurb with dates and an example migration snippet.

docs-bot: preview available: https://deploy-preview-3421--redwood-docs.netlify.app/migration/embed-dim  :white_check_mark:

sam: Action items:
- @carol open docs PR with example + checklist
- @maya update SDK snippet templates and add regression test
- @ben add rollout notes to internal runbook (canary + fallback)
- @alice verify tutorials that assume embed dims
I'll mark owners in the PR description.

carol: Opening PR now, will ping the thread when ready for review (ETA today EOD).

maya: I'll add a unit test that asserts the example snippet compiles with both client major versions and flags a lint warning if param names mismatch.

ben: Small nit for the runbook — include a canary traffic recipe to fallback to 'embed-legacy' on dim mismatch, and a short query to detect mismatches in logs.

alice: Thanks everyone. If anyone hits backward-compat tests failing in CI, tag me and I'll take it.
